SILENTREBALANCE-CONCENTRATE.title: Concentrate
CALCULATED_GAMBLE.description:
Discard your [gold]Hand[/gold],
then draw that many cards.
CORROSIVE_WAVE.description: Whenever you draw a card this turn, apply {CorrosiveWave:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to a random enemy.
MASTER_PLANNER.description: Each turn, the first non-[gold]Sly[/gold] Skill you play gains [gold]Sly[/gold].
WRAITH_FORM.description:
Gain {IntangiblePower:diff()} [gold]Intangible[/gold].
At the start of your turn, lose {WraithFormPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
